Its integrated service platform lets customers consolidate multiple operational requirements with a single provider, spanning soft services (housekeeping, security, staffing, payment management, business support) and hard/technical services (infrastructure, repair and maintenance, telecom, technology-enabled surveillance, cash-van transportation).

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The industry is characterised by manpower dependency, pricing pressure, evolving customer requirements and regulatory obligations; competition from organised and regional service providers may impact margins and customer acquisition costs.
- Customers evaluate providers on compliance, manpower, financial capability, technology adoption, service quality and execution; competitive pressure could affect the Company's ability to win and retain contracts.
- Management flags the need to maintain execution discipline and manage working capital prudently while expanding operations, indicating scaling-related operational risk.
- Operations are significantly dependent on the availability, deployment, training and supervision of a large workforce; effective workforce management is required to maintain service quality and contract compliance.
- Increasing regulatory and compliance requirements are noted as a factor for the sector, and the Company's Secretarial Audit Report notes some irregularities in compliance with provisions of the Act, Rules, Regulations, Guidelines, Standards and Listing Agreement during the audit period.
- The Company operates a technology environment with real-time monitoring; increased cyber-attack scenarios in the environment are explicitly flagged as a risk area under review, notwithstanding no incidents reported during the year.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:

- Integrate: increase the proportion of bundled, multi-service contracts and strengthen cross-selling across the existing customer base.

- Execute: maintain strong contract execution, operational discipline, service quality, customer satisfaction and financial control.
